svg.font-family: Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How sprezzature works
svg.desc: Flow diagram. At the top, a sentence typed to an agent feeds two lanes. The left lane is the agent layer, this repository: it matches the sentence to a skill through a declared vocabulary and reads that skill's reference documents rather than a memory, handing back one contract. The right lane is the tool layer, ten standalone packages: each is installed on its own and published through five surfaces, a library, a command line, an HTTP API, an agent tool surface and a skill. Both meet in one outcome, an artifact that was made and then audited by a gate that exits non-zero.
svg.text: How sprezzature works
Ten engines, each published through five surfaces, and the skills that know when to reach for them.
A sentence you type to Claude or OpenCode
"make this page accessible", "chart this CSV", "wrap this command line in a form", "map this by country"
The agent layer: this repository
Match the sentence to a skill
each skill declares the vocabulary that should reach it,
and TRIGGERS.md is that table, generated from the ten descriptions
rather than written beside them.
Read the reference, not a memory
the rules live in references/ as text the model reads
at the moment it needs them. That is what lets a smaller local model
follow a script instead of inventing one.
One skill, and its contract
the same folder serves Claude Code and OpenCode, so
a runtime choice is not a rewrite
The tool layer: ten standalone packages
Install only what you need
pip install sprezzature-colors on its own, or the whole suite
under one name. Each package releases on its own schedule.
Five surfaces over one engine
a library, a command line, an HTTP API in a container, the same
routes republished as agent tools, and a skill. The engine
is written once and the five are thin wrappers, because a surface
holding logic of its own gives the engine a second version
of the truth.
A deterministic tool
the same input gives the same artifact, byte for byte. That
is the half a model cannot be asked to reproduce from memory.
Something made, and then audited
Every skill pairs a generator with an auditor that exits non-zero on findings, which is what makes it a gate rather than a suggestion.
Where a model is needed, alt text, plain-language rewrites, captions, it runs on your own machine.
The skills define the contract between the agent and the packages. Everything that can be decided without a model is decided without one.
